title: Battery Optimization Whitelisting request?
symptom: Opening xDrip+ shows a 'Battery Optimization Whitelisting' request that appears every time and lasts a few seconds, then disappears. It persists after updating to the latest release.
cause: The request is a feature of the phone/Android system, not an xDrip setting.
fix: Turn off battery optimization for xDrip in the system settings.
evidence_quote: That's a feature of your phone/Android. You have to turn of battery optimization for xDrip in the system settings.
